description: This file defines the UriComposer class implementing the IUriComposer interface. It constructs URIs for product images by replacing placeholders with actual catalog base URLs, utilizing CatalogSettings.

classes.name: UriComposer
classes.description: Provides functionality to compose image URIs based on a template and catalog settings.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
methods.description: Replaces placeholder in the URI template with the actual catalog base URL from settings.
